claim_boundary.supports: The pinned Rust source lists ten axiom NAMES with no predicate attached; the only enforcement is GenesisAdmissionKernel::admit_difference, which checks a != b (A1) and then carrier membership. Kernel-checked for arbitrary name types: the transcribed kernel accepts a pair iff a != b and both are in the carrier, checks A1 first, never inspects the token (acceptance is token-independent) and keeps its admitted pairs irreflexive and inside the carrier (INSTANCES: duplicates and both orientations are accepted); the reflexive-transitive closure is the least preorder containing a relation (A3); the face boundary of a coboundary vanishes for every potential iff the three boundary edges are all present or all absent (and the decidable form A5 of the instance section is equivalent to that nilpotence); a coboundary descends to the quotient by im d0 iff d1 o d0 = 0, so A7 read as "d1 vanishes on im d0" (our reading of an unpinned gloss) is A5 again; any Nat-valued defect of the form inf over phi of N(h - d0 phi) is gauge invariant (A6; the rational-valued Phi1 of the source is not covered, and its gauge invariance is tested natively only for shifts in {-1,0,1}^n); for the TRANSCRIBED rule rcl (none exactly when Phi = 0 and Gamma != 0, Gamma read as the coboundary) the exact-but-not-closed cell is empty iff d1 o d0 = 0 and nonempty otherwise. The source cannot reach its own None branch through compute_triad_signature: its complex constructor rejects d1 o d0 != 0 (gamma2.rs verify_chain_law), it refuses a face with a missing edge (test_triad_refuses_malformed_input) and its Gamma2 is evaluated on the Phi1 residual. Native tables, in the PRODUCT model (D, E, F, alpha) on carriers of 1, 2, 3 points with at most one face (0,1,2), present only for n = 3: A1 reads the admitted relation D, A3/A4/A5/A7 read the evaluation relation E and the face flag F, and A10 is read from a free flag alpha with no further content, so independence of A1 and A10 from the other axioms is true by construction and the one computed interaction is A4 versus A5. Order of violate_only is [A1, A3, A4, A5, A7, A10]: all-axiom models 1, 12, 2304; A1, A4 and A10 are each violable alone from one point (counts 1, 1, 1 at n=1; 36, 52, 12 at n=2; 16128, 38656, 2304 at n=3); A3 is never violated; A5 and A7 fail together (entries 4 and 5 of violate_only are structurally 0), jointly only from n=3 (1152 structures) because the encoding has a face only for n=3. A5 without well-formedness (a floating face with no boundary edge present) holds in 65536 structures at n=3. In the product model the empty structure is always a model and each off-diagonal pair lies in exactly half the models; since A2 is not a state predicate this shows only that the encoding forces no admission. The kernel facts are a transcription of admit_difference checked against a reading of the pinned source (the checker re-simulates it; no gate executes the real GenesisAdmissionKernel). Also native: closure counts 1, 4, 29 preorders and six named complexes with exact/closed/rupture counts, the transcribed rule rcl evaluated on (Phi1, coboundary L1 norm) per cochain, and gauge invariance of the unit-weight L1 distance.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: A derivation of the axiom list (obligation GEN-WDP-O01 and paper pin tfq_0394 stay open: this is a transcription and a small-model study, not a justification); that the predicates for A2, A4 and A6-A9 are the intended ones (the pinned file has names only; the one-line glosses come from an external copy of the file whose bytes differ from the pin); independence of A1 and A10 as a finding about the axioms (it holds by construction of the product model); A9: the relabelling check is an isomorphism (permuting vertex labels while keeping the cochain index-wise) and cannot fail, so it says nothing about observer-selected metrics; carriers of more than 3 points; real-valued Phi1, Gamma2 and R_cl values (here Phi1 is the unit-weight L1 distance to im d0 in integers and Gamma the L1 norm of d1 h); that the exact/closed classification equals classify_exact; any reachability of the source r_cl None branch; the Born, Hilbert or physical reading of any axiom.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: In a small product model (carriers of at most three points, at most one triangular face, A10 a free flag), the transcribed axioms A1, A4, A5 and A10 are jointly satisfiable and A1, A4, A10 are each violable alone from one point and A5 (together with A7) from three points; A3 holds because a reflexive-transitive closure is a preorder; A7 is A5 under the reading of A7 as d1 vanishing on im d0; the kernel enforces only A1 and carrier membership (the token is stored, never checked); and the transcribed R_cl rule refuses exactly on the exact-but-not-closed cell that d1 o d0 = 0 empties, a branch the source cannot reach because it rejects d1 o d0 != 0 at construction. This is evidence about a transcription of the list, not a derivation of it.
claim_boundary.next_test: Obtain the definitions of A2, A4 and A6-A9 from the FOC-006 / FOC-000 sources (not bound here), replace the gloss-based predicates by them, and decide whether A9 is independent at all: test it with a weighted L1 norm whose weights are not permuted with the vertices (an observer-selected metric), since the present relabelling check is an isomorphism and cannot fail.
